Mara: Quick sync: finalize benchmark story for the launch post + 30m webinar. Focus: median latency vs $/1k tokens and routing for inbound leads.
Alex: Lead visual = scatter (median latency x, cost per 1k y), color by deployment. Secondary = area chart showing cost at scale.
Priya: Headline suggestion: 'Predictable latency. Clearer inference economics.' Subhead: 'Compare hosted, dedicated, and private with consistent metrics.'
Sam: I'll export CSV with fields: deployment_mode, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_request. Violin for tail variance as interactive layer.
Noah: Routing rule: if Expected_RPS >= 50 OR Compliance includes SOC2/PCI/HIPAA -> Enterprise queue; else Growth. Tag leads with Benchmark_Interest (latency/cost/throughput). Use SFDC fields Expected_RPS__c, Compliance_Requirements__c, Benchmark_Interest__c.
Mara: CTA: 'Run your workload on Redwood	60 get a tailored latency & cost report in 48h.' Form asks expected RPS, avg tokens/request, compliance. Hidden Demo_Priority__c set when RPS >=50.
Alex: Avoid vendor name comparisons. Add methodology footnote: tokens = prompt + completion; Dedicated uses reserved pools.
Sam: CSV upload link (placeholder): https://internal.redwood/bench/exports/1769998888.csv. Will deliver by EOD.
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested for 2026-06-10 16:00 UTC. Confirm within 48h. :calendar:
Mara: Confirmed. Action items: Sam CSV, Priya landing copy, Noah SFDC mapping, Jen outreach (assigned offline). Check back here with updates. :thumbsup:
